title: NASA's innovative propulsion program funds warp drive research
summary: Eric Haseltine tells of NASA's innovative propulsion program funds warp drive research, about recent at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the National Security Agency, the US government's electronic spying agency, spoke on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels about a NASA programme for new and unusual ways of moving spacecraft. According to him, this programme, which he calls fantastic, has funded research into warp drive, an idea for travelling faster than light by bending space itself. He points to a document called The Shadow of Time, and if he is right, it would mean the US space agency takes seriously ideas that sound like science fiction.
